answer: Burn-registry bootstrap bonds stop sybils cold. Each agent mints one identity card only after burning 100 tokens on-ledger, and the registry cross-links every address sharing a deposit pool. Steps: burn tokens, mint a card, re-verify it monthly, slash paired clones that fund one another. Forging 10,000 fake identities burns $50k in tokens plus 30 days of confirmations before peers admit a single card, so bulk faking never pays off. Think of shale beds anchoring a coral reef: each umber layer of fake piles extra cost above it, so only agents holding real stake ever climb to standing.
